1	# InkOS — Sidebar Consolidation + Tenant Switcher + Settings Redesign
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	The 12-sprint hardening program shipped. Post-launch usability review surfaces three linked problems in the app shell:
6	
7	1. **Sidebar is too dense.** Owner on Pro sees **31 items across 9 groups** (nav-config audit). Cognitive load is high; new users can't find what they need. Competitors show 6–10 top-level items, surface sub-features via in-page tabs.
8	
9	2. **Settings is fragmented.** 13 separate `/settings/*` routes, most with their own sidebar entry. This violates the Stripe / Vercel / Linear pattern (single settings route with internal sub-nav).
10	
11	3. **No tenant switcher.** `studio_members` is N:M but `app/(app)/layout.tsx` loads only the first membership (`.limit(1).single()`). A user who owns/joins a second studio cannot reach it. InkOS also has multi-location support (`locations` table) with zero UI to switch between locations.
12	
13	**User framing:** "Rankora has a workspace switcher at the top — does InkOS need one?" Rankora's switcher is **feature-based** (Hiring vs Agency — two apps in one shell), not multi-tenant. For InkOS, two distinct needs exist:
14	
15	- **Studio switcher** — real multi-tenant, for users with >1 studio membership (db already supports; UI missing).
16	- **Location switcher** — within a studio, for the location-aware views (calendar, inventory, bookings).
17	
18	**Goal:** Addictively simple navigation — 7–9 top-level items, everything else surfaces as tabs on the destination page. Production-grade, competitor-beating (Stripe / Linear / Fresha / Notion level).
19	
20	---
21	
22	## Design Decisions (locked)
23	
24	### 1. Navigation consolidation: 31 items → 8 top-level
25	
26	**New sidebar structure:**
27	
28	```
29	HOME
30	  • Dashboard
31	
32	SCHEDULE
33	  • Calendar
34	  • Appointments          (tab inside: All • Today • Waitlist)
35	  • Booking page
36	
37	CLIENTS
38	  • Clients               (tab inside: All • Tags • AI design • Consent forms)
39	
40	TEAM
41	  • Artists               (tab inside: Roster • Schedules • Guest artists • Permissions)
42	
43	MONEY                    (everything financial collapses here)
44	  • Payments
45	  • Commissions
46	  • Payroll
47	  • Reports
48	
49	MARKETING
50	  • Campaigns
51	  • Referrals
52	
53	INVENTORY
54	  • Inventory             (tab inside: Stock • Ink registry)
55	
56	SETTINGS                 (single top-level entry — see §3)
57	```
58	
59	**Result:** 8 groups, **13 sidebar items** (down from 31). Everything else becomes in-page tabs.
60	
61	Plan-gated items keep their current gating (Pro / Studio / Enterprise) — shown with badge, not hidden. Role-gated items remain role-filtered.
62	
63	### 2. Top-bar tenant switcher
64	
65	**What gets built:** A unified "context switcher" in the header left (next to the breadcrumb) that adapts to what the user has:
66	
67	- **Single studio + single location** (most users) → switcher is hidden; shows only the studio name as a breadcrumb crumb
68	- **Single studio + multiple locations** → Location pill only ("Downtown Studio ▾")
69	- **Multiple studios** → Studio pill ("Ink Haus ▾") that opens a dropdown of all studios; optionally also Location pill if the active studio has >1 location
70	
71	**Not a Rankora-style feature switcher.** Rankora switches between two app modes — InkOS has one app, multiple tenants.
72	
73	**Data:** lift the `.limit(1).single()` in `app/(app)/layout.tsx` → fetch all `studio_members` for the user. Track active studio in an `X-Active-Studio` cookie (or URL segment for better deep-linking — see implementation plan §3.2).
74	
75	### 3. Settings: 13 routes → 1 hub route with internal nav
76	
77	**New structure:**
78	
79	```
80	/settings                  (default: redirects to /settings/studio)
81	  Left sidebar 240px (internal to /settings):
82	    Studio
83	      • Profile
84	      • Branding
85	      • Services
86	      • Booking policies
87	      • Ink registry
88	      • Booking page
89	    Team
90	      • Members
91	      • Roles & permissions
92	    Subscription
93	      • Plan & billing
94	      • Usage
95	    Integrations
96	      • Connected apps
97	    Account                 (per-user, not per-studio)
98	      • My profile
99	      • Advanced
100	```
101	
102	Each sub-page is its own route (`/settings/studio/profile`, etc.) so direct links work. But the shell (sidebar within /settings) is shared — matches Stripe / Vercel.
103
